Design intent:
Simple traffic light controller with two states. In state S0 the light is green. In state S1 the light is red. The controller toggles state whenever tick is high on the rising edge of the clock. Reset returns to S0.

Buggy RTL:
module traffic_fsm (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst,
    input logic tick,
    output logic green,
    output logic red
);
    typedef enum logic {S0, S1} state_t;
    state_t state, next_state;

    always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst)
            state <= S0;
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    always_comb begin
        next_state = state;
        case (state)
            S0: if (tick) next_state = S1;
            S1: if (tick) next_state = S1;
        endcase
    end

    always_comb begin
        green = 0;
        red = 0;
        case (state)
            S0: green = 1;
            S1: red = 1;
        endcase
    end
endmodule
